metadata.description: Azure region for all resources
Environment name, used in resource naming (e.g. prod, dev)
Base name for the project, used in resource naming
Administrator login for the PostgreSQL Flexible Server
Administrator password for the PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Pass at deploy time, never commit a real value.
Admin email for ASP.NET Identity seeding. Leave empty to skip creating an admin account (matches the app's existing graceful-skip behavior).
Admin password for ASP.NET Identity seeding. Leave empty to skip creating an admin account.

Web container image reference. Defaults to a public placeholder so infra can be provisioned before CI/CD has pushed a real image to ACR; the deploy pipeline overwrites this via az containerapp update.
Worker container image reference. Same placeholder convention as webImage.
Extra non-secret environment variables for the Web app, e.g. Blockchain__Network__* settings that must not be templated into version-controlled Bicep. Pass at deploy time.
Extra non-secret environment variables for the Worker, mirroring additionalWebEnvVars.
GitHub repository in owner/repo form, for the CI/CD OIDC federated credential
Branch the CI/CD identity is allowed to deploy from

Branch this identity is allowed to authenticate from

Principal ID of the CI/CD identity that manages temporary firewall rules for running migrations. Leave empty to skip.

Globally unique name for the storage account (lowercase alphanumeric, 3-24 chars)
Principal ID of the user-assigned managed identity that reads/writes blobs
Name of the blob container used for receipt PDFs

Globally unique name for the Service Bus namespace
Principal ID of the user-assigned managed identity that sends/receives messages

Name for the Email Communication Service resource
Name for the Communication Services resource
